name: Cheese omelette
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper until no streaks remain.
Melt the butter in a nonstick pan over medium-low heat until it foams.
Pour in the eggs and gently pull the edges toward the center as they set, tilting the pan so raw egg runs underneath.
When the top is just set but still glossy, scatter the cheese over one half, fold, and slide onto a plate.

name: Chicken fried rice
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large pan over high heat. Add the chicken and cook 5–6 minutes, stirring, until no longer pink inside and it reaches 165°F; move to a plate.
Add the remaining oil, then the onion and peas; cook 2 minutes.
Push everything aside, crack in the eggs, and scramble until just set.
Add the rice, breaking up clumps, and fry 3 minutes until hot. Return the chicken, add the soy sauce, toss and serve.
